big_case.notes: Emergency application by twelve intervenor states to stay a final judgment enjoining a presidential executive order on federal election administration, traveling with a parallel presidential application (26A124), months before the November 2026 midterms; the pair's resolution stayed the injunction pending appeal. Among the highest-stakes interim matters of the Term.
